sourcePaths.normalization: Rust --remap-path-prefix normalizes registry panic-location labels to the prefix embedded in the existing deployed artifact. It does not relocate source files or patch Wasm bytes.
sourcePaths.reason: The existing deployed Wasm includes Rust dependency panic locations. Keep these historical labels stable across Cargo home directories without editing the deployed artifact.

observedReproduction.scope: Source rebuild matched the committed deployed binary exactly on the original macOS arm64 host, including after registry-prefix normalization. Independent macOS CI must also require exact equality. Linux x64 was tested with the same pinned compiler and normalized source prefix and produced different bytes; its successful source compilation is not deployment reproduction.
